A Practice Built On Trial Experience

Five years in the courtroom, from the District Bench to the High Court.

Mian Umair has built an active litigation practice spanning District Courts up to the High Court, representing individuals in family, criminal and civil matters, and advising public-sector utility clients on corporate and commercial compliance.

“A litigation practice is only as credible as the record behind it — courts, clients, and institutions, not marketing copy.”
